changelog:
soulmd-newsletter 1.0.0

- Initial release with a command-line tool to fetch and display the latest SoulMD newsletter from RSS.
- Includes detection of new editions and stores state locally.
- Outputs newsletter title, date, link, subscribe URL, and an excerpt.
summary: Fetches and displays the latest edition from the SoulMD newsletter RSS feed, including title, date, link, and a brief excerpt.
